name: Supabase RLS basics
author: Anvil contributors
description: Flags a service_role key in front-end code and asks a human to confirm row-level security on user tables.

checks.title: Supabase service_role key in front-end code
checks.why: The service_role key bypasses row-level security entirely.
checks.fix: Rotate the key in Supabase and only use it on the server.

checks.title: REST root answers without a session
checks.why: An open REST root often means tables are listable by anyone with the anon key.
checks.fix: Enable RLS on every table and add policies per role.

humanChecks.prompt: Signed in as user A, can you see any of user B's rows?
steps: Add a row as user B
Sign in as user A and look for it
